title: Herb Crusted Australian Lamb Skewers
description: Savory and crisp lamb skewers with a delicious herb crust, perfect for a crowd, featuring instant yeast and shio-koji-cure for a unique flavor, and FODMAP-friendly ingredients for all to enjoy.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together yeast, shio-koji-cure, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to form a paste.
Add the paste to the lamb cubes and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with garlic-infused oil and season with salt, black pepper, rosemary, and thyme.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional rosemary and thyme, if desired.
